summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose its stock repurchase program disclosures to the ASX. The program authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate share repurchases of Class A and Class B common stock. No specific price, premium, or timeline is stated. The board has previously authorized the program, and the filing is a routine update of daily transactions as required by ASX rules. The filing does not announce new terms or material changes. The repurchase program is ongoing and subject to market conditions and legal constraints. Investors should monitor periodic disclosures for actual execution pace and any expansions or suspensions.
